name: Media Scroller
description: A Slick-based media/image field formatter that renders a horizontal scroller.
project_description:
Media Scroller 
 Provides an Media Carousel field formatter for Image fields and Media Image fields in Drupal 10 and 11.

The formatter displays images as a synchronized slider with thumbnail navigation using the Slick carousel library. 

 Features 
 
 Supports Image fields 
 Supports Media reference fields (Media → Image) 
 Image style selection per formatter 
 Main slider + thumbnail navigation 
 Responsive and mobile-friendly 
 Multiple sliders per page supported 
 Drupal asset library integration
